body:
The journey began in a nice wooden house in the middle of nature. I was invited by my friend, she is shaman, spiritually developed, connected to Higher Consciousness the same shit Tesla was talking about Akasha records/ quantum field where all data are available.
At the end of my trip my throat chakra opened. I was coughing, spilling, suffocating. The shaman tapped in to my vibration and started with cleaning and moving my body... Then I started to believe. I didnt believe until the experience with bufo alvarius powder 5-MeO-DMT.
I was inhaling vapor through a light bulb (thank you Edison!) for 10 s and than holding in for another 10 s. Then......light.....and bammmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmm, I was having multiblast orgasm with Creator. The colors were greeny-yellow, but the feeling was so intense that I have forgotten how intense it was, because I can not integrate it into linear reality here and now. We humans are interdimensional beings, but the FUCKING SYSTEM (you know who) convinced us that we are SHIT. People wake up, I will... The process will be slow, but I will discover why I am on this earth, and why were so fucking asleep. Peace brothers and sisters!
